cardEffects:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
[On Deletion] You may DNA digivolve 1 of your [Machinedramon] in play and 1 [Kimeramon] in the trash into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
inheritedEffect: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
name: Kimeramon

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT18-015 (2024/06/21, translated by DeepL)
Official JP Q&A for BT18-015 (2024/11/22, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: Yes, the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met.  In addition, DNA digivolution can't be performed unless the [Millenniummon] has DNA digivolution.
rulings.question: If I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand, do the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met for [Millenniummon]?

rulings.answer: Yes, that's correct.  The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card is placed in the trash, therefore this card itself in the trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
rulings.question: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect allow my [Machinedramon] and this card itself in the trash that activated the effect to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand?

rulings.answer: You can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] from your hand by using your [Machinedramon] in the battle area and your [Kimeramon] in the trash.
rulings.question: For this card's [On Deletion] effect, which locations must the [Machinedramon] and [Kimeramon] be in to DNA digivolve to [Millenniummon] from the hand?

rulings.answer: Your [Machinedramon] in the battle area and [Kimeramon] in your trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
rulings.question: What are the areas where [Machinedramon] and [Kimeramon] can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand using this card's [On Deletion] effect?

rulings.answer: Yes, DNA digivolution requirements must be met. Also, "Millenniummon" without DNA digivolution cannot have DNA digivolution.
rulings.question: When this card's [On Deletion] effect digivolves Joggles to a "Millenniummon" in my hand, does it have to meet the digivolution requirements for that "Millenniummon"'s Joggles?

rulings.answer: Yes, it is possible. Since the [On Deletion] effect is activated after the card is placed in Trash, this card in Trash itself can DNA digivolves to "Millenniummon" in your hand.
rulings.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect digivolve [DNA digivolves] to [Millenniummon] in my [Hand] with my [Machinedramon] and this card itself in the trash that activated this effect?

rulings.answer: With your "Mugendramon" in the Battle Area and "Kimeramon" in your trash, you can DNA digivolve to "Millenniummon" in your hand.
